name: kanban
title: Kanban board
description: Columns with WIP limits and cards you drag between them or reorder, by pointer, touch or keyboard. Optimistic moves with rollback and Retry, a context menu, a details sheet and assignee and label filters in the URL.

Try again.") if (toColumnId === "done" && card && card.assigneeIds.length === 0) throw new Error("Assign someone before closing a card.") } const toList = (value: string) => (value ? value.split(",") : []) export function TasksBoard({ columns = SAMPLE_COLUMNS, cards = SAMPLE_CARDS, labels = SAMPLE_LABELS, people = SAMPLE_PEOPLE, }: { columns?: KanbanColumn[] cards?: KanbanCard[] labels?: KanbanLabel[] people?: KanbanPerson[] }) { const [assignee, setAssignee] = useUrlState("assignee") const [label, setLabel] = useUrlState("label") const [failAll, setFailAll] = React.useState(false) const assignees = toList(assignee) const labelIds = toList(label) const visible = React.useMemo(() => { if (!assignees.length && !labelIds.length) return undefined const wantedAssignees = new Set(assignees) const wantedLabels = new Set(labelIds) return (c: KanbanCard) => (!wantedAssignees.size || c.assigneeIds.some((a) => wantedAssignees.has(a))) && (!wantedLabels.size || c.labelIds.some((l) => wantedLabels.has(l))) // The URL strings are the stable identity of both lists. // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps }, [assignee, label]) const byId = React.useMemo( () => new Map(cards.map((c) => [c.id, c])), [cards] ) const personOptions = React.useMemo( () => people.map((p) => ({ value: p.id, label: p.name })), [people] ) const labelOptions = React.useMemo( () => labels.map((l) => ({ value: l.id, label: l.name })), [labels] ) return (
